name: leos-tests
description: LEOS automated test suite — Playwright (browser-mode E2E) + Vitest (API & DB) against an isolated local server.

scripts.desktop:install: npm install --prefix desktop && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run package:win --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:package:dir: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run package:dir --prefix desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:db && npm run test:e2e
